title: Surreal Mind Portal
description: A surreal painting depicts a cracked classical head statue split open, revealing an ornate theater stage with stairs and a film reel. An orange-clad figure stands on the stage operating a movie projector. Above floats a large red all-seeing eye with green drips, while a black cat-like creature and red poppies appear in the foreground.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork of a cracked white classical male head statue split open like a theater stage, an orange worker figure standing on film reels and stairs inside the head operating a movie projector, giant red all-seeing eye floating above with green slime dripping, purple curtains, bats and film strips, black feline creature in foreground, red poppies, dramatic light rays, dark background with white paint splashes
